mentions.name: wherebox
mentions.description: This API service generates static map images of any requested location, returning the rendered image for the location you need. It can be used via a plain URL request, a standard API, or MCP.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the weekends, i work on http://wherebox.dev, a static maps API that returns you image with location you need. Works via URL request, API or MCP.
